figures.caption: Figure 2: The overview of the proposed HD-REC. (a) HDQ constructs Semantic IDs through globally shared coarse-level quantization and adaptively routed fine-level quantization. (b) DAS MoE combines an always-active shared expert with a dynamically selected specialized expert. (c) CRCL encourages coherent expert-routing decisions among tokens belonging to the same item.

Table 2: The overall results of competing baselines and HD-REC on three cross-domain datasets. The best and second-best results are highlighted in bold and underline, respectively. “Impr.” denotes the relative improvement of HD-REC over the strongest baseline. The t-tests showed significant performance improvements (p ≤ 0.05).
Figure 3: The results of hyper-parameter experiments on the Clothing and Sports dataset.
